records.proof: Rapid decay makes all boundary terms vanish. The eigen-equation gives integral(yprime²+a²t²y²)=lambda*integral(y²). Expanding integral(yprime+a*t*y)² and integrating2a*t*y*yprime yields(lambda-a)*integral(y²)>=0. Gaussian exp(-a*t²/2) attains equality and solves the equation, so the minimum is a. The integral of(t*exp(-a*t²))prime is0, giving normalized moment1/(2a).
records.optionsVisibleAssessment: All choices positive. Scaling leaves both1/(2a) and2/a; it does not decide the factor. Recognizing the energy factorization and its equality case, or an equally valid spectral argument, is substantive. Retain the existing Olympiad editorial assessment; no extra independent-idea credit.
